energy.city_electricity_scope: Illustrative city-facing electricity intensity only; excludes the separately modeled bulk transfer lift and seawater desalination, and excludes separately unmodeled construction and major industrial/process loads.

demonstration_mix.basis: EIA 2024 Arizona utility-scale PV capacity factor (28.7%) used as a reference, not a forecast. Portfolio rating is treated as AC; land sensitivity converts to DC with a separate ratio assumption.
EIA 2024 United States utility-scale wind capacity factor (34.3%) used as a reference, not a site forecast.
EIA 2024 United States nuclear-fleet capacity factor (90.8%) used as an availability reference, not an SMR guarantee. At the legacy 50-MWe module assumption this is 3,000 modules.
EIA 2024 United States geothermal fleet capacity factor (64.6%) used as a reference; the project's resource and achievable capacity are unknown.

Conditional electrical output calculated by recalculate.py at 476 m3/s, 4,000 ft gross aggregate head, and 90% conversion efficiency; the 70% capacity factor is illustrative. Not an allocation, firm yield, or validated nameplate rating.
Residual arithmetic allocation to make the example total 1,000 GW; not a proposed coastal resource, site, or capacity forecast. Requires a separate coastal/offshore resource and transmission case.

hydrogen_storage.basis: Hydrogen fuel cells are modeled as discharge equipment for stored energy. Electricity used for electrolysis is the primary input; the stated round-trip efficiency is an illustrative system assumption.

illustrative_capacity_ramp.status: Scenario-only analyst inputs; not canonical milestones, an optimized deployment schedule, or a physical construction plan.

first_operation.basis: Combine the existing 80 x 50-MWe SMR arithmetic case with the existing 476-m3/s, 1,200–2,500-ft conditional hydro sensitivities. The hydro figures are electrical-output proxies before site/net-head validation, not firm ratings.

later_milestones.label: Long-range 1-TW goal; no completion year assigned

city_water_labels: EPA at-home U.S. comparison (82 gal/person/day ≈ 310.4 L/person/day)
water.bulk_transfer_model: Read from recalculate.py so the 29.75 km3/year flow, 4,000-ft static lift, pump input, and conditional one-pass recovery stay tied to the canonical Grand River recalculation. Desalination is an optional separate case, not automatically part of that flow.

land.area_scope_note: City boundary, solar array area, wind project envelope, and reservoir surface are separate model quantities. Wind envelope is not fully disturbed land. Do not add them into a surveyed project footprint or assume sites do not overlap.

air.airflow_scope_note: A scale illustration only, not an ASHRAE code rate or a claim that every resident is indoors simultaneously. Actual outdoor air is space/occupancy and floor-area specific; system-level ventilation effectiveness and applicable local codes must be applied.

milestones.note: Establish source, site, demand, rights, land, ecology, air, transmission, and safety evidence; no project-wide build capacity is assigned.
Target first operational dam-and-city module around 2046. Size any pilot to a separately defined service boundary; no first-operation census or GW target is assigned.
First 20-year construction/supply-chain window; add modular works and generation only against measured/declared phase loads and gates.
Early-phase aggregate gross-head aspiration across distinct stages; no individual dam height, reservoir depth, or capacity milestone is implied.
The ~40-million regional-service figure stays separate and is not added to this city population.
Long-range fictional aggregate-head target and provisional 1-TW installed/nameplate multi-source ambition; no final completion date or source allocation is set.
